# Discovery — Promemoria

## Assumption under test
Clinic owners lose at least two paid hours a week to no-shows. [assumption:unvalidated]
**Would be falsified by:** five owners whose last month shows fewer than two no-shows a week

## Method
5 interviews across small clinics · no sources mined · 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-25
**Saturation reached:** no, five is the floor

## Participants
| Code | Role | Segment | Class |
|------|------|---------|-------|
| P1 | owner | 2 therapists | paying-badly |
| P2 | owner | 3 therapists | paying-badly |
| P3 | owner | 4 therapists | paying-badly |
| P4 | owner | 5 therapists | tolerating |
| P5 | owner | 6 therapists | tolerating |

## Evidence
Every owner counted two to six no-shows a week last month. [interview:P1] [interview:P2] [interview:P3] [interview:P4] [interview:P5]
Each lost hour is worth 45 euro. [interview:P1]
Receptionists spend about 40 minutes a day phoning. [interview:P2]

## Disconfirming evidence
**Sought:** owners with fewer than two no-shows a week
**Found:** none among five [interview:P1] [interview:P5]

## JTBD
When a slot is booked, I want to know early whether the patient comes, so I can fill the hour. [interview:P3]

## Surprises
None observed; five owners from one region limit it.

## Verdict
**VALIDATED** — all five lose two or more hours a week [interview:P1] [interview:P4]
**Chosen by:** Mario, "continue"
